subject: info-af-b
title: (R)INFO.AF.B.------AFN.
description: Chart on book p. 417 (MID-W-11). INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; AFN (affinity negation) is the partner. The main line runs from the subject to POL-CON (political consciousness), where it bends, and on to AFN. From AFN: CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) and ALT-D (alternative definitions). From CULT-INFO-F: IST-F (isolated focus). From ALT-D: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From IST-F: PROJ (projection). From PROJ: R-INTR. IST-F has the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
